purpose: Test whether one explicit Active/Fresh agricultural N pool improves transferable TN prediction after the L0-v2 hydrologic and finite-mineral repair.
mechanism_isolation_control: ActiveLegacy_v2__KFAST_CONTROL using the identical manure/residue ledger and q_active=1 per month

external_forcing_completion_amendment.reason: Complete the already-registered primary Dryad residue-removal constraint after official files became locally available; no TN result was used to choose the source or annual values.
external_forcing_completion_amendment.mapping: residue_return_fraction interface = 1 - China-mainland annual off-field residue-removal percentage; 2023 carried to 2024
external_forcing_completion_amendment.bounded_interpretation: This is an explicit upper-bound non-off-field mapping, not observed soil return, because Dryad excludes in-field burning and does not separate grazing from decomposition.

within_month_order: add mineral fertilizer, BNF, deposition, mineral manure and mineralized N
actual crop uptake and product/returned/removed-residue accounting
candidate-specific frozen daily fast/percolation/slow TN transfer and fixed mineral other-loss
add organic manure and actual returned residue as one end-of-month new Active/Fresh batch

external_constraints.mineralizable_soil_n: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.19998062; basin Active stock and at least 95% of Reaches must remain below the study-balanced p95 mineralizable fraction of total soil N (20.282799%)
external_constraints.crop_recovery: You et al. 2023 source data are an envelope diagnostic only and are not reused as independent validation
external_constraints.IMM_FIXED: not executable after Dryad endpoint preprocessing: aggregate gaseous, runoff/leaching and soil-isotope observations do not uniquely map mineral N to a monthly Active/Fresh immobilization operator
external_constraints.protected_sensitivity: closed in this run because no externally locked h/kP endpoint mapping is available

mechanism_gate.primary_comparison: ActiveLegacy_v2__IMM0 versus ActiveLegacy_v2__KFAST_CONTROL on population_transferable temporal OOF
mechanism_gate.active_rate_boundary_confounded: k_active at either bound in at least 2 of 3 temporal folds
mechanism_gate.spatial_requirement: nested LORO, LOTO and natural expansion in 20260824_43 before mainline promotion

shared_with_parent: frozen canonical daily hydrology and station-position Q
forbidden: use R1 regionalization before nested spatial validation
